## About
Fig Earth Supply is a neighborhood nursery on N Figueroa St in Los Angeles. We carry flowers, herbs and veggie plants, along with gloves, hoses, tools and good soil.
Whether you have a backyard bed or just a balcony with a few pots, we'll talk through which plants make sense, what size pot they need and what soil to use. One reviewer came in for a single tomato plant and went home with peppers, strawberries, peppermint and cilantro too.
We're rated 4.7 from 70 Google reviews. And yes, there are usually a couple of kitties hanging around.

## Services
- Flowers, herbs and veggie plants: A good selection of plants for a starter garden, a kitchen herb patch or a few pots on the balcony.
- Gardening supplies and soil: Gloves, hoses, tools and good soil to get your garden going.
- Help with herb arrangements: Sanjay and the team can help you put together an herb arrangement, with tips on plant care along the way.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: Yes. On Sunday we're open 9:30 AM to 5:00 PM.

Q: Where are you?
A: You'll find us at 3577 N Figueroa St, Los Angeles, CA 90065.

Q: I've never gardened on my own. Can you help me get started?
A: Yes. Tell us what space you have and what you'd like to grow, and we'll walk you through plants, pots and soil. One first-time balcony gardener said we helped her get started with confidence.

## What customers say
- "I don't ever write reviews for various reasons. But I just wanted to encourage people to go to FES because of how I ended up loving it! I researched a couple of nurseries before hand and was still making a decision when I happened to be passing sort of nearby driving from Pasadena to Echo Park. Best decision I could've made. The two people who helped me (I wish I could remember names!!) were so informative, each in their own way. I have some experience in gardening from my youth, but I've never done it on my own before, and now I only have a balcony so I'm limited to potted plants. I felt like I was given all the information I needed to make a decision -- I was mainly looking for a tomato plant that will tolerate a pot and they helped me get started with confidence. Ended up leaving with more than just the tomato plant (super peppers, strawberries, peppermint, and cilantro all came home with me!) because of their wonderful selection and helpful answers to my question. Also felt well informed about the pot sizes, soil needs, etc for each plant I was buying. All the plants I brought home were healthy and resilient. I can't recommend this place enough for anyone looking for fruit and veggie plants, a starter garden, herbs, etc. Wonderful people and a great nursery." (k.d. Bromley, 5/5)
- "I absolutely love fig earth supply! At the beginning of the Covid-19 shutdown, when everyone was getting their gardening on, I got everything I needed from Fig Earth Supply and the local Eagle Rockdale garden. Fig Earth though, introduced me to high quality gardening supplies (gloves, hoses, tools), good soil, and I hear they have amazing workshops (I will attend one day, I promise). The contactless pick up was a game changer for me. I ordered online, paid, and picked up in the window I chose and everything would be ready outside with my name on it. Places like this really boosts the mood when you're stuck at home. Even though I eventually killed all my vegetable plants from neglect, I may start again when spring comes around and I know I'll be going back to Fig Earth Supply." (Jin Y., 5/5)

(Payton Williams, 5/5)
